name: signup-rest
description: PURE REST Notion signup — zero clicks, zero form automation. Replays the web client's own auth endpoints: getLoginOptions → sendTemporaryPassword → (code read from the v3-mail worker inbox) → loginWithEmail → session cookies captured. Email must be a NAMED priv.email alias (admin@/support@/noreply@/billing@/security@) so the code email dual-delivers into the v3-mail worker where this macro can read the body. The Notion-Client-Version header is read live from the signup page (it is REQUIRED — requests without it are rejected). Verified end-to-end 2026-08-25 (see docs/NOTION-REST-AUTH.md).

steps.function: return fetch('/emails?address=' + encodeURIComponent('{{inputs.email}}') + '&limit=1', { credentials: 'include' }).then(r => r.json()).then(d => ({ sinceId: ((d.results || [])[0] || {}).id || 0 }));

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); const t = d.loginOptionsToken || ''; if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'no loginOptionsToken in getLoginOptions response', body: (args.body || '').slice(0, 200) }; return { loginOptionsToken: t }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); const s = d.csrfState || ''; if (!s) return { ok: false, error: 'no csrfState in sendTemporaryPassword response (email may be rate-limited — wait and retry)', body: (args.body || '').slice(0, 200) }; return { state: s }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); if (d.error) return { ok: false, error: 'loginWithEmail failed: ' + JSON.stringify(d).slice(0, 200) }; return { isNewSignup: !!d.isNewSignup, userId: d.userId || '' }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { userId: map.notion_user_id || '', tokenV2: map.token_v2 || '', deviceId: map.notion_device_id || '' }; }
